exact_statement: For every fixed K>=0 the actual distinct-dependent-controller family F_n with controllers Maj_n(z), Maj_n(z)*w and delta=1/64 violates G_V(F_n)<=2delta G_V(h_n)+K I_DATA(F_n) at sufficiently large odd n. Its exact residual is (delta/2)n phi(d_m^2)-delta n d_m^2+S_m+Dstar-4delta, |S_m|<=7, -49<=Dstar<=56; hence it is >=log2(m+1)/256-57. Root J_y=0. Retaining the marked y owner cancels the logarithm and gives G_V(F_n)<=2delta G_mark(h_n)+256 I_DATA(F_n) for all odd n>=3. H(F_n)/I(F_n)<15 under the stated threshold-paper theorem. This refutes only the unmarked combined-owner rule and root-only singleton repairs, not FEI or the marked universal route.
